consequence.statement: Existing NodeClaim objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten. A storage version migration that rewrites all objects, followed by an update to status.storedVersions, must run before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Rewrite all NodeClaim objects so they are stored as v1, then remove v1beta1 from status.storedVersions on the nodeclaims.karpenter.sh CRD.

assertion.statement: The storage version of nodeclaims.karpenter.sh changes from v1beta1 to v1, so existing NodeClaim objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before a later release removes v1beta1.
